intelligence.enrichment: A clustered column graph combines related column graphs by drawing bars side by side for each category, using different visual encodings to separate datasets and a common scale to compare bar heights or lengths.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Mathematics question. Chapter: math/grade_07/ch_205. The student must decide: Represent and compare two or more related datasets with clustered or double column graphs by using adjacent bars, a common scale, and visual distinctions such as colours, patterns, or legends. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
